part.text: The regression coverage is already present in `JsonWriterTest`: lenient primitive doubles are expected to serialize as pseudo-numeric literals. I’ll align the finite-value guard with `value(Number)` while preserving the existing literal conversion path.

+   * @param value a finite value unless this writer is {@linkplain #isLenient() lenient}.

-    if (Double.isNaN(value) || Double.isInfinite(value)) {
